536.DSCR:
Former president of $$アクシオン$$ Corporation, the predecessor of the $$アクシオン$$ Foundation, and the biological father of $$カルロス・アクシオン$$ Jr., the founder of the $$アクシオン$$ Foundation.
His true identity was the head of the family holding supreme authority in $$クロノ$$, a subordinate organization of $$サイデリアル$$, which has managed the people of Earth since the distant past, and he inherited the codename $$キング$$.
During the $$時獄戦役$$ he cooperated with $$ガドライト#pilot$$ and pulled strings from the shadows, but after $$サイデリアル$$ began ruling Earth directly, he withdrew from the front line and held the position of a bystander.
536.DSC2:

In his heart he harbored feelings for his late son, who had refused to inherit the position of $$キング$$, and out of doubt about the way he himself and $$クロノ$$ existed, he sometimes took anti-$$サイデリアル$$ actions.

537.DSCR:
Former representative of the $$国連$$ Peacekeeping Council, and currently Supreme Commander of the Earth Federation Forces.
When he was representative of the Peacekeeping Council, he formed a special international rescue team that acted beyond the bounds of organization and position for the peace and happiness of all humanity.
He possesses a strong will that does not hesitate at immediate sacrifice, but voices of suspicion have also been raised over his forceful methods and his unreadable true intentions.
Also, though its truth is unconfirmed, records remain suggesting he has lived for over 200 years, and there are many mysteries surrounding him.
His true identity was one of the '$$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$', those who touched '$$クロノエイチ$$'.
To entrust humanity's future to those who would carry on afterward, he gave up his life.

538.DSCR:
The true identity of $$ＡＧ$$, a person who gained tremendous power through the $$黒の英知$$.
The name is a general term for the same person across parallel worlds, and each of them holds special power through the influence of the $$黒の英知$$.
Currently, in order to achieve a pseudo true evolution into a higher-dimensional life form, $$ジ・エーデル#pilot|lc$$s across parallel worlds have fused. Among them, $$ジエー・ベイベル$$ of the $$ＵＣＷ$$, who led $$カイメラ$$ and holds the strongest power of all, serves as the representative, and $$エルガン・ローディック$$ of the $$ＡＤＷ$$ serves in the position of assisting him.
Because $$ジエー$$'s personality forms the base, he is faithful to his desires and has a streak of regarding others as nothing but tools, but his will to overthrow the $$御使い$$s is genuine, and for that purpose he does not hesitate to cooperate with others.
Also, owing to the influence of the other personalities and the like, he is more cooperative than $$ジエー$$ himself, but $$ジエー$$'s peculiar self-tormenting hobbies are still alive and well, and his intentions and actions are difficult to read.
Incidentally, his looks are those of the bizarre-featured $$ジエー$$, but even this is not a drawback to him, and he thinks it is 'Delicious!'
Even after his true identity came to light, he was forced to remain in the form of $$ＡＧ$$. However, he himself liked the position of the dimensional merchant '$$ＡＧ$$' and accepted it.

カルロス・アクシオン.evidence: Jigoku library English: 'Carlos Axion Jr.' (Jigoku glossary: カルロス = Carlos); the entry itself gives アクシオン財団 = Axion Foundation, which Jigoku library English also writes 'Axion Foundation'. The entry writes the Jr. suffix separately (Ｊｒ．), kept outside the token

アクシオン.evidence: Jigoku library English: 'Axion Foundation'; same romanization as in カルロス・アクシオン

エルガン・ローディック.evidence: Jigoku glossary: Elgan Roddick (official). Not in the akurasu wikis. The Jigoku library English of the Z EXtra International Savers entry spelled it 'Elgan Roadick', but the glossary form wins

エルガン#pilot.evidence: Given name of Elgan Roddick (Jigoku glossary: Elgan Roddick)

ジ・エーデル・ベルナル.evidence: Jigoku glossary: ジ・エーデル・ベルナル = The Edel Bernal (official); Jigoku library English also 'The Edel Bernal'

ジ・エーデル#pilot.evidence: Same as kw_000 proposal; Jigoku glossary: The Edel Bernal (official). Used here with |lc and a plural s: 'the Edels across parallel worlds'

ジエー・ベイベル.evidence: Jigoku library English (Ji-Edel Bernal entry): 'the ugly old scientist Jie Beibel'. Not in the akurasu wikis

ジエー.evidence: Short form of ジエー・ベイベル (Jigoku library English 'Jie Beibel')

カイメラ.evidence: Jigoku library English (Ji-Edel Bernal entry): 'the ringleader of Chimera'; カイメラ is the katakana of the English word chimera

クロノ.evidence: Same as kw_000 proposal: Chrono (Chrono Reformists / Chrono Conservatives). No wiki entry found

サイデリアル.evidence: Same as kw_000 proposal: akurasu Z3.R Story Summary 'Sidereal'

時獄戦役.evidence: Same as kw_000 proposal: derived from 時の牢獄 = Time's Prison + 戦役 (war)

御使い.evidence: Same as kw_000 proposal: literal (御使い = divine messenger). Used here with a plural s outside the token

クロノエイチ.evidence: The katakana form クロノエイチ (kuro no eichi) is the reading of 黒の英知 (glossary: Black Wisdom, proposed); the Jigoku entries for Elgan and for Ji-Edel Bernal say he 'touched the Black Wisdom'. Proposed as an alias of 黒の英知 with the same English

uncertain: pilot 536: 遥か過去から地球人を管理してきた can modify either サイデリアル or クロノ; I kept it attached to サイデリアル (nearest noun) with a comma clause. kw_000 says クロノ manages humanity's history, so it may belong to クロノ
pilot 536: 株式会社アクシオン rendered 'Axion Corporation' (株式会社 = joint-stock company); no official English. 実父 rendered 'biological father'

pilot 536: 'the codename King' left as plain English (as in kw_000, where the King is plain text). The sheet has a pilot token キング = King (proposed); I could not tell whether it is the same office, so I did not tokenize it
pilot 536: 'anti-Sidereal' is the token with a literal prefix 'anti-' outside it

pilot 537: he/his used for Elgan (a known character; the Jigoku English of the same person, keyword 45, uses he). The Japanese has no pronoun. Present tense 現在は総司令官 kept as 'currently' even though the entry ends with the death; this mismatch is in the Japanese. 総司令官 = 'Supreme Commander' follows Jigoku. The Jigoku ZEXIS name is not in this Tengoku entry, so it is written as 'a special international rescue team'

pilot 537: 「クロノエイチ」 is the reading of 黒の英知 (kuro no eichi); I used a new token $$クロノエイチ$$ proposed as 'Black Wisdom' instead of the sheet token 黒の英知 so the source is not altered. Orchestrator should decide whether to merge it. Also 'one of the The Edel Bernal' reads awkwardly because of the token English 'The Edel Bernal'; consider settling the English (for example 'Ji Edel Bernal') for the whole library
pilot 538: 擬似真化 rendered 'pseudo true evolution' (真化 = shinka, as in 真化融合 elsewhere); no wiki. 自虐的な趣味 rendered 'self-tormenting hobbies'. 「美味しい！」 rendered literally 'Delicious!'

pilot 538: 因果地平 rendered 'causal horizon' (could also be event horizon). 消滅しようとする力 rendered 'the force that seeks to vanish'. In the last sentence アドヴェントと共に残った is read as modifying the force ('remained together with Advent'), not as 'he and Advent together took in the force'
pilot 538: 超時空修復 is written as plain 'hyperspacetime restoration' as in kw_000, not the sheet's 時空修復 = Spacetime Repair token, since the source is 超時空修復
pilot 538: he/him for ジ・エーデル is settled by the Japanese (彼)
